name: monitor-binary-version-baselines
description: Establish and maintain longitudinal baselines of CLI binary contents across versions. Covers marker selection by category (API / identity / config / telemetry / flag / function), weighted scoring, threshold-based system-presence detection, and per-version baseline records. Use when tracking a feature's lifecycle across releases, when probing for dark-launched or removed capabilities, or when verifying that a scanning tool still catches known-good markers on old binaries.
